focus: Coordinated project-read cancellation before/during NSFileCoordinator wait and bounded read; detached task/token handoff; exactly-once completion; suppression of late successful results.
inspection_method: Remote pinned-source review through GitHub fetch_file; no local execution.

inspected_paths.scope: Integration signature and cancellation propagation only; internal polling review belongs to w077

checks.observation: Both entry paths call a cancellation checkpoint before reading; the native test gates entry until after cancellation.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review.

checks.observation: The operation awaits the sole detached worker inside a cancellation handler, forwards cancellation to worker and token, and checks parent cancellation after worker.value; worker success cannot bypass the post-await checkpoint.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review.

checks.observation: A lock serializes token state and coordinator installation. Cancellation sets a sticky boolean, so an earlier cancel rejects installation; a later cancel obtains a strong local coordinator reference. The following checkpoints detect cancellation even before coordination begins.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review.

checks.observation: cancel() is forwarded to the installed coordinator. After coordination returns, cancellation is checked before either coordinationError or accessor result is returned. Existing native test holds a registered presenter and requires completion before release.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review; runtime outcome not executed.

checks.observation: The same token checkpoint is passed as a throwing bounded-reader callback. The typed ReadError catch does not intercept CancellationError. Cancellation checks surround decode and occur after coordination.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by integration source review.

checks.observation: Coordinator reference access is lock protected. cancel() copies a strong reference before unlocking; finish() clears the stored reference without clearing the cancelled state. There is no shared mutable coordinator slot accessed without that lock.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review.

checks.observation: One detached Task supplies the result; cancellation does not independently resume a continuation or publish a value. The synchronous coordinator accessor stores a Result, and outer cancellation checks precede success return. No duplicate completion path identified.
checks.result: No concrete defect identified by source review.

checks.observation: Existing source tests cover pre-entry cancellation for both APIs, presenter-wait cancellation, presenter errors, successful immutable read, and malformed/oversized input. Deterministic every-instruction race injection is not present; coverage absence alone is not classified as a product defect.
checks.result: Source review only; does not satisfy native runtime acceptance.

external_references.purpose: Confirmed Apple's documented cross-thread cancel support, immediate return, cancellation of presenter waits, and requirement that an already-running accessor finish.
